quotes.text: Oznacz jako utracone: powoduje zablokowanie urządzenia kodem PIN, wzorem lub hasłem.

claims.reason: Backed in the readable Google snapshot: securing the device (remote lock) and, for a Google account only, securing the account (line 172 points to another page, it does not give the steps). Not backed: securing the phone number or SIM card (line 120 concerns disabling the device by IMEI, not the card or number) and securing bank accounts. Those parts rest on the Apple and Rzecznik Finansowy pages, which have no snapshot (blocked).

claims.reason: The Google help page gives the same advice for Android and Wear OS (mark as lost = lock; preconditions listed in the preparation section, which matches 'jeżeli ta funkcja była dostępna'). The sentence says 'producenta' in general; the iPhone part rests on the Apple page, which has no snapshot (blocked, HTTP 429). Google here is the Android service provider, the page does not say it is the phone manufacturer's service for every Android brand.

claims.claim: Powiadom operatora o utracie karty i ustal jej zabezpieczenie.

quotes.text: Operator sieci komórkowej może użyć numeru IMEI urządzenia, aby je wyłączyć.

claims.reason: Only the role of the mobile operator is backed: the Google page says the operator can disable the device using its IMEI. Not backed: a duty or advice to notify the operator, and anything about the SIM card or its protection (the snapshot never mentions a SIM card). The item attributes operator contact to the Apple page, which has no snapshot (blocked). The link to the Apple row is not used as a dependency because that row has no quote.

claims.claim: Jeśli zagrożony jest dostęp do banku lub widzisz obce operacje, skontaktuj się pilnie z bankiem oficjalnym kanałem.
claims.reason: The item attributes this advice to the Rzecznik Finansowy FAQ (Korzyść i dowody#3). That page has no snapshot (access blocked by the service, snapshot null). The only readable snapshot (Google help page) never mentions a bank or unauthorised transactions (read in full; keyword search for 'bank' found no hit). Verdict source_unavailable follows step 0 of the role file, although step 2 lists only not_applicable, partly and unsupported for recommendation_derived rows.

Searched the only readable snapshot (Google help page) for police, reporting a theft or law enforcement: no hit. The page mentions a stolen device only on line 172 and gives no advice to report it. The item attributes this advice to no source. The Apple and Rzecznik Finansowy snapshots do not exist (blocked), so whether they contain it could not be checked.

claims.claim: Nie czekaj na zakończenie jednego zgłoszenia, jeżeli inne ryzyko jest pilne.
claims.reason: Searched the only readable snapshot (Google help page) for any advice on the order of actions, doing steps in parallel or not waiting for one report to finish: no hit. The item attributes this advice to no source and its own Ocena dowodów says the sources are not a study of the order of actions. The Apple and Rzecznik Finansowy snapshots do not exist (blocked).

The sentence has two parts of the same kind, so one row with the weaker verdict.

claims.reason: The Rzecznik Finansowy FAQ page on unauthorised transactions has no snapshot: access blocked by the service (HTTP status 200 but blocked), snapshot null. Nothing in the readable Google snapshot concerns payment instruments or unauthorised transactions.

scope_gaps.note: Title promises securing the device, the number and at-risk accounts; readable evidence covers only the Android device and, by a pointer, the Google account.
Google page covers Android and Wear OS devices only; nothing about iPhone or other platforms. Apple page unchecked.
Evidence is Android only (Find Hub); the sentence addresses any phone and any manufacturer.
Snapshot says nothing about a SIM card ('karta'), notifying the operator or securing the card; it only says the operator can use the IMEI to disable the device.
No readable source on banks, unauthorised transactions or contact channels.
No readable source on reporting a theft to the police; jurisdiction (Poland) not addressed by any snapshot.
Evidence covers Android and Wear OS only; the sentence reads as platform-neutral.
Google also says SD cards may not be wiped by the erase; the sentence does not mention it. Erasing there means a factory reset from Find Hub, not other methods.
Absence shown only in the stored main region of the Google page; the other two sources could not be searched.

notes: Apple (support.apple.com/pl-pl/101593) and Rzecznik Finansowy (rf.gov.pl FAQ) have snapshot null and access blocked, so all claims attributed to them are source_unavailable and no claim was answered from memory. Only the Google snapshot 7d4296b28eab6e78.txt was readable: main article region only (keptChars 9122 of wholeChars 11280), and the page ends with a note that it may contain AI-translated text with possible errors (line 186). Status FAIL comes from two unsupported recommendations (W praktyce#4 police report, W praktyce#5 not waiting for one report to finish): the item attributes neither to a source and the readable snapshot is silent, but the blocked Apple and RF snapshots might change that after a re-fetch. Opened only: the role file, AGENTS.md, the packet and snapshot 7d4296b28eab6e78.txt (Read, plus one Grep on that exact path). No protocol violation.
